tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background of paper cards, with 8% multiply grain.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Footnotes, sources, subtitles. Passes contrast on paper; #7a7266 failed.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and thin chart lines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oxblood. The one accent: the number that matters and the FIG. kicker only.

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: Captions on footage, with a soft shadow. Captions on paper use ink.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left and right page margin on a 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: caption-bottom
tokens.usage: Caption baseline distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep all text at least this far from every frame edge.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Paper pages and photo insets have square corners.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: anything arriving. GSAP: power3.out is close.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits: leave fast, don't linger. GSAP: power2.in.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moves between two states: footage into the page frame and back.

tokens.name: word-stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between words of a headline as they arrive.

tokens.name: enter
tokens.usage: One word or line arriving (rise 30px, blur 12px to 0).

tokens.name: frame-move
tokens.usage: Footage shrinking into the photo frame, or growing back.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum time a line stays still to be read.
